empirical_behavior.heuristic_rule_discovered: If Time > 90.5: Status is ALWAYS OFF (100% of 18,310 rows). If Time <= 90.5 and Soil Moisture <= 59.5: Status is predominantly ON

provenance_and_target_verification.assessment: Status represents an artificial rule-based simulation output or benchmark script rather than verified agronomic field irrigation events

sequential_validity_audit.synthesis_verdict: The dataset is a synthetic composite: randomly shuffled/i.i.d. soil simulation rows juxtaposed with an independent meteorological weather sequence. The meteorological sequence has zero correlation (r < 0.01) with the target Status.

weather_api_pipeline: Open-Meteo current weather (temperature, wind_speed, air_humidity, wind_gust, pressure)

sequence_construction_and_gap_analysis.sequence_dynamic_assessment: Because soil moisture autocorrelation is zero, 24-step sliding windows contain 24 independent random draws rather than a physical depletion trajectory.

embargo_buffer.purpose: Prevent sliding sequence windows from straddling train/val and val/test partition boundaries

leakage_safe_split_design.scaler_protocol: StandardScaler.fit() strictly on training sequence inputs; transform() on validation and test
leakage_safe_split_design.shuffling_rule: Strictly chronological; zero random shuffling of sequences prior to split

target_options: Instantaneous Status[t] aligned to end of sequence
proposed_dl_models.semantic_mismatch: The target Status has no temporal dependency on past values (soil moisture autocorrelation is -0.002). Feeding 24 historical timesteps provides zero temporal predictive signal and forces neural networks to memorize spurious correlation.

data_sufficiency_and_complexity_justific.justification: While 23k samples is numerically sufficient for small neural nets, the signal-to-noise ratio in the temporal dimension is zero. Inductive biases of LSTM, TCN, and Transformer assume temporal coherence and dynamics. On i.i.d. sensor records, deep sequence models risk extreme overfitting and poor generalization compared to simple tree classifiers.

common_specifications.expected_performance_vs_rf: Inferior or equivalent to HistGradientBoostingClassifier; zero theoretical advantage

lstm_protocol.architecture: LayerNorm(11) -> 2-layer LSTM(hidden=64, dropout=0.3) -> FC(64->32) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.3) -> FC(32->1)

tcn_protocol.architecture: 3 Causal Dilated Residual Blocks (channels=64, 64, 128, kernel=5, dilations=[1, 2, 4]) -> Linear(128->1)

transformer_protocol.architecture: Linear(11->32) -> Sinusoidal PE -> 2-layer TransformerEncoder(d_model=32, nhead=4, d_ff=64) -> Pooling Head -> Linear(32->1)

LSTM.reason: Soil moisture has zero autocorrelation (-0.002); 24-step sequences are uncorrelated noise. Recurrent hidden state provides no predictive value over a single-step decision tree.

TCN.reason: Causal convolutions with receptive field > 24 timesteps capture zero genuine temporal dynamics on i.i.d. synthetic data; 198k parameters will overfit spurious weather fluctuations.

Transformer.reason: Self-attention over 24 timesteps of non-sequential soil readings is mathematically ungrounded; quadratic attention computation yields zero domain benefit over tabular gradient boosting.

unresolved_assumptions: Ground truth definition of 'Status' (heuristic simulator vs physical irrigation)
Origin and meaning of 'Time' column (0 to 110 integer)
Domain transferability from iotsensordata.csv integer scale (1-90) to live ESP32 capacitive relative scale (0-100%)
Physical source and sampling protocol of the stitched meteorological block
recommended_next_steps: Maintain training/models/random_forest_11feat.pkl as the sole active advisory model on the dashboard
Keep automatic pump actuation strictly disabled (PUMP_ALLOWED = False)
Permanently retire the legacy deep learning models (improved_lstm.pt, tcn.pt, transformer.pt) from operational consideration
Collect genuine, timestamped continuous time-series sensor logs from the deployed ESP32 and Open-Meteo pipeline before considering sequence modeling in future research phases
If improved accuracy is required, install an inexpensive DS18B20 soil temperature probe on the ESP32 to restore the 13-feature baseline model (ROC-AUC 0.7927)
